title: naam par shaah ke paani
body:
naam par shaah ke paani jo pila dete hai
meere kousar inhei'n mujrayi dua dete hai
<<DIVIDER>>
qatl akbar sa pisar hota hai sheh karte hai shukr
sabre ayyub ko shabbir jila dete hai
<<DIVIDER>>
fatima kehti hai dunya me ye aabaad rahei'n
sheh ka pursa mujhe sab ahle azaa dete hai
<<DIVIDER>>
chashme sajjad agar zouf se ho jaati hai band
ashqiyaa'n paao'n ki zanjeer hila dete hai
<<DIVIDER>>
roke kehti thi sakina ke hamei'n qaid kiya
log zindaa'n se yateemo'n ko chudha dete hai
<<DIVIDER>>
poochta hai jo koi kisne kamar ko toda
shaah abbas ke laashe ko bata dete hai
<<DIVIDER>>
arz aabid ne ye ki maangta hoo'n jab paani
mujh ko dikhlaake sitamaar baha dete hai
<<DIVIDER>>
zib'ha shaabir ko karta hai layee'n qanjar se
bose hulqoom pa mehboobe khuda dete hai
